prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of CERES, Roman goddess whose favor gives fruitful harvests and whose wrath brings blight, drought and famine.
ANATOMY: one matronly human woman, exactly one head and two arms, fully opaque heavy ochre and ivory flowing draperies, a prominent broad crown woven from unmistakable wheat ears. One hand grips a single worn agricultural sickle with a curved iron blade; the other hand opens toward the ripening crop. [ceres-c06, ceres-c07]
MOMENT: stride toward the viewer and sweep the sickle low across the foreground as wind lifts the folds of her robe; stern maternal face looks down with overwhelming authority. Fresh tall wheat brushes the opened hand, while dry withered wheat and cracked drought soil occupy the opposite lower corner.
POWER: physically show the contrast between her blessing and anger: dense heavy golden ripe wheat on one side, curled blighted stems and cracked dry soil on the other. No hand beams, magical ribbons or flames. [ceres-c02]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low-angle close framing from between wheat stems; the foreground sickle, enormous folds of robe, face and broad wheat crown fill the square, not a distant woman in a landscape. Apparent grandeur from framing, no literal giant-height claim.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one sharp setting sun behind her wheat crown, narrow amber rim and deep walnut facial shadows; loose crop chaff blows across foreground.
SURFACE: rough woven drapery, rusted iron sickle edge, individual wheat husks, grain dust, fissured earth.
SETTING: agricultural field at harvest, filling the lowest foreground with documented crop contrast; only sliver of distant sky. [ceres-c01, ceres-c02]
MOOD: awe-inspiring sacred authority over food and famine, stern yet benevolent, not evil; never placid, cute or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; exactly one head and two arms, no extra limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from films, games, anime or comics; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Wheat-crowned matronly Ceres advancing with sickle between abundant and drought-stricken grain.

visual_requirements.description: Matronly woman in opaque flowing draperies and broad wheat-ear crown.
Abundant ripe wheat contrasts physically with dry withered stems and drought-cracked soil, without magical beams.

aura: Contrasting crop bounty and drought manifest Ceres authority over harvest and famine (ceres-c02), enhanced by foreground sickle and wheat crown (ceres-c06/c07).
artistic_choices: Close camera creates monumental impression, not documented literal giant size.
Contrast of blessing and anger is a visual juxtaposition of two attested outcomes, not a claim of simultaneous new magical attack.
Stride, sickle sweep, crop chaff, sunset, cloth colors and weathered materials are editorial composition.
